description: NeoForge 1.21.1 addon for GraveStone Mod enabling ender pearl-powered obituary teleportation.

mods.name: GraveStone Teleport Addon
mods.description:
An addon for the GraveStone mod by Max Henkel (henkelmax).

Lets you charge the obituary item with an Ender Pearl (crafting recipe), showing a glowing
indicator once charged. Right-clicking a charged obituary teleports you back to your grave
and consumes the charge; shift + right-click still opens GraveStone's own death-info GUI.

This addon does not include, modify, or redistribute any GraveStone code or assets - it only
reads the public death-location data GraveStone itself stores on the obituary item. GraveStone
must be installed separately for this addon to do anything.

item: Combine with an Ender Pearl to enable teleportation
Right click to teleport to your grave
